[1;38;5;202;49maut[0m[1;38;5;140;49mh_k[0m[1;38;5;34;49mey[0m2048 bit, exchanged through Diffie-Hellman when logging into a new device, known to client device and server. All the remaining bytes are used on both directions of communication
